issues.reason: Role fillers are lowercase entity terms and `(Year n)` is defined only as a structured Time-term value (UpperCamelCase term constructor), so `(Patient sk_begin_1 (Year 2))` is ill-typed — the same term is simultaneously used correctly as a Time value on line 5, which is exactly the type confusion.

Cardinality is stated to take `a native integer`, and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only as a Measure magnitude or an approximate clock value, so the distribution in the count slot is ill-typed and breaks the `Compute` hard-integer counting machinery the instruction set pairs with Cardinality.

The rule cited (`a noun modifier is never exposed`) bars `(Inheritance salt_bloom_store salt_bloom)`, which the parse does not emit; `(Inheritance salt_bloom bloom)` is the hyphenated transparent modifier+head genus the same section says to `always emit`, whether decomposition reaches a compound nested inside a compound is simply unstated, and the atom is true and well-typed.

Identical case to index 2 — `(Inheritance mire_essence essence)` is a compound genus, not the barred exposure of a noun modifier as the store compound's genus, and it is true and well-typed in gap territory.

The half that stands: `recover from` is a prepositional verb and its object does not answer `whence`, so the licensed head is the preposition-named `(From sk_recover_1 sk_loss_1)`; the half that does not: `Source` is the instruction set's own listed head for an event-side `from` oblique and the atom is true, well-typed and asserts nothing extra, so it is a head-choice error rather than false content.

gaps_confirmed: A hedged cardinal ("About ten sky-cats"): Cardinality requires a native integer and CardinalityPhrase covers only vague phrases carrying no number, so an approximated exact count has no licensed carrier.

A measure-of quantity phrase ("eight weeks of supply", "eleven weeks of winter supply"): the of-phrase rules explicitly exclude a measure ("a cup of water") from the genitive mapping but never give it an encoding.
new_gaps: The instruction set states no link between a named-year entity symbol (year_2, licensed by Names and casing) and the `(Year n)` Time term, so "Year 2 began on day 365" and `(Time e (Year 2))` cannot be related in the KB.

Whether compound decomposition reaches a compound MODIFIER nested inside a compound (salt_bloom inside salt_bloom_store, mire_essence inside mire_essence_store) is unstated — "decompose once, then stop" names a stopping condition only for parts already single.

`(Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>)` specifies the scale as the associated event or an explicit -est dimension; a kind-ordinal over a non-eventive class ("the second autumn equinox") supplies neither, leaving the scale slot unlicensed.
defect_summary: For index 0 the compliant form is a named entity for the year — `(Name year_2 "Year 2")` + `(Member year_2 year)` per Names and casing (the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word), with `year_2` filling the Patient slot and `(Year 2)` staying in Time slots only. For index 1 NO licensed form carries the content: Cardinality admits only a native integer and CardinalityPhrase only a numberless vague phrase, so the instruction-compliant behaviour under Core patterns ("carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap") is to omit the count atom entirely and file the gap — which is why the hedged-cardinal gap above is the substantive finding here.
notes: The reviewer's second gap is not a gap: Names and casing does license an entity symbol for "Year 2" (capitalized run exceeding the bare class word); the real gap is the missing bridge to the `(Year n)` term, filed above. The light-verb reading of "came" over the equinox event-noun (reviewer's note) is acceptable improvisation — every atom it yields is true and well-typed.
